title: No imagePullSecrets defined in any template
detail: Pods cannot authenticate to a private registry.
remediation: Add imagePullSecrets, or grant AcrPull to the kubelet identity.

title: Security: Root file system is not read-only
detail: An immutable root file system prevents applications from writing to their local disk. This can limit intrusions, as attackers will not be able to tamper with the file system or write foreign executables to disk.

title: Security: Default security context configured
detail: Security context controls the allocation of security parameters for the pod/container/volume, ensuring the appropriate level of protection. Relying on default security context may expose vulnerabilities to potential attacks that rely on privileged access.
remediation: To enhance security, it is strongly recommended not to rely on the default security context. Instead, it is advisable to explicitly define the required security parameters (such as runAsNonRoot, capabilities, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.) within the security context.

title: Route TLS termination requires a secretName
detail: The source Route specified TLS. The emitted Ingress references .Values.route.tlsSecretName, which is not yet defined.
remediation: Provision/import the TLS secret on AKS and set route.tlsSecretName in the environment's values file.

title: LLM reviewed and updated this file
detail: Generated fresh by the model this run. Set FREEZE_OUTPUT=true in migration.env once you're happy with the result to lock it in.

title: Server-side validation skipped (offline mode)
detail: helm --dry-run=server and kubectl auth can-i require cluster access.
remediation: Re-run with --mode connected once credentials are available.
